audit.whatIsWrong: The entry is written against Tahm Kench's pre-rework kit. Devour is called his W in spikes[3].text ("Tahm Kench's W Devour"), wants.you[2] ("his W Devour roam"), wants.foe[0] ("chain into W Devour"), whys[4] ("his W Devour's roaming threat") and mid ("his favourite Devour angles ... his W roam into the jungle").
audit.why: In the current kit Devour is his R and his W is Abyssal Dive — a 1000-1200 range leap that knocks up on landing, 21/20/19/18/17s. The two do completely different things: the roam/gap-close threat the entry keeps describing is Abyssal Dive, while Devour is the single-target removal. A player told to watch for a "W Devour roam" will be watching the wrong ability and the wrong cooldown.
audit.corrected: Abyssal Dive (W) = the leap/knockup gap-closer and roam tool, 21s at rank 1. Devour (R) = eats a champion.

audit.whatIsWrong: Eleven fields treat Tongue Lash as a stun on demand — "Tongue Lash (Q) stun", "his Q stun window is reliable", "bait that stun", "He cannot chain Q into W Devour without landing the stun first". The An Acquired Taste stack mechanic is never mentioned anywhere in the entry.
audit.why: Tongue Lash does not stun by itself. Riot's text: it applies a stack of An Acquired Taste, and only "If the champion already has 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, they are stunned and the stacks are consumed." Devour likewise needs three stacks to be usable on a champion. This is the entire matchup — the counterplay is denying the third damaging hit and letting stacks fall off, not dodging one telegraphed stun. Blinding Dart is doubly valuable here because a blanked auto is also a denied stack.
audit.corrected: Tongue Lash stuns only at three An Acquired Taste stacks, and Devour needs three to be castable on you. Deny the third hit and neither exists.
sources: champ-data/_kits/tahmkench.json (P An Acquired Taste, Q Tongue Lash)

audit.whatIsWrong: Grey health is repeatedly attributed to his passive: wants.you[0] "his grey-health passive", whys[2] "his grey-health passive brings him back", wants.foe[1] "Devour's passive sustain".
audit.why: Grey health is Thick Skin, his E. That matters because Thick Skin is not passive-only — it has an active on a 3s cooldown that converts all stored damage into a temporary shield. Treating it as passive regen hides the actual decision point, which is bursting the stored damage off before he converts it.
audit.corrected: Thick Skin (E) stores grey health and its active converts it to a shield on 3s — spend his stored damage before he can bank it. His passive is An Acquired Taste.
sources: champ-data/_kits/tahmkench.json (E Thick Skin, P An Acquired Taste)

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] (Lvl 4-5) says "mushroom the river bush and tribush", wants.you[2] says "Mushroom the river brush and tribush at Levels 4-5", and mid says mushrooms "can blanket the river bush, tribush ... plant them before the 4-minute mark".
audit.why: Noxious Trap is Teemo's ultimate — there are no mushrooms before level 6. Three separate fields build the levels 4-5 plan around an ability the player does not have, which wastes the one window that is actually decided by spacing alone.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 are pure spacing; mushrooms start at 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: mid: "His Tongue Lash range is roughly 800 units".
audit.why: Tongue Lash is 900 range against Teemo's 680, so the gap he outranges you by is 220 units rather than the 120 the entry implies — nearly double, which changes where you can safely stand to last-hit.

audit.whatIsWrong: "Blinding Shot" in spikes[0].text, early, whys[0]; "Liandry's Angueur" in spikes[1].text and whys[5].
audit.why: Teemo's Q is Blinding Dart. "Liandry's Angueur" is not a real item; the full layer already writes Liandry's Torment.

Packet suspectNames flagged "Abyssal Mask" in wants.foe[2] and "His Tongue Lash" in mid as probable wrong names. Both are false positives: Abyssal Mask is a real MR item and a normal Tahm Kench buy, and Tongue Lash is the correct Q name. I left both alone. The near-miss was against Abyssal Dive, which is a different ability that happens to share a word.

notes: This entry is the weakest of the nine: it is written against Tahm Kench's pre-rework kit (Devour as W) and never mentions An Acquired Taste, which is the mechanic the whole lane runs on. Both errors are almost certainly present in every other Tahm Kench matchup in the file — worth a global grep for "W Devour" and for any Tongue Lash line that calls it an unconditional stun. Also note the packet's suspectNames gave two false positives here (Abyssal Mask, His Tongue Lash); I left those strings alone. WKM_LINES not inspected.
